name: robots/apirrone__open_duck_playground
title: Open Duck Mini V2 (MuJoCo rough terrain, backlash)
intro: Open Duck Mini V2 (MuJoCo rough terrain, backlash), adapted from apirrone/open_duck_playground. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
